modules.moduleTitle: 1. Urinary Tract Obstruction & UUO/BUO Hemodynamic Pathophysiology
modules.studyGuide: 本模組深入傳授 Obstructive Uropathy 的核心生理與病理變化。重點剖析 Intrinsic vs Extrinsic Causes、Retroperitoneal Fibrosis 常侵犯輸尿管中段與超音波診斷偽陰性機制、Renal Resistive Index (RI cut-off 0.7) 於急慢性阻塞之鑑別診斷、Unilateral Ureteral Obstruction (UUO) 阻塞後三階段血液動力學變化 (Phase I/II/III RBF與PT動態) 與晚期 GFR 下降介質、UUO vs BUO 解除阻塞後之電解質處置 (特別強調 UUO 解除後 Phosphate Retention 生理機制)、Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD) 發生條件與輸液處置、以及阻塞後腎臟纖維化之分子機轉 (Ang II/TGF-β1) 與介入用藥。

sections.heading: Urinary Tract Obstruction: Intrinsic vs Extrinsic Causes & Ultrasound Diagnostic Pitfalls

diagram.caption: Figure 1.1: Anatomical Classification of Urinary Tract Obstruction, Ultrasound False Negative Mechanisms in Retroperitoneal Fibrosis, and Renal Resistive Index (RI) Calculation.

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 37.1: Renal Ultrasound showing Normal versus Hydronephrotic Kidney with Dilated Calices and Pelvis.
Brenner 11e Fig. 37.3: Non-contrast Computed Tomography of Hydronephrosis showing Dilated Renal Pelvis and Calices.
Figure 1.1: Anatomical Classification of Urinary Tract Obstruction, Ultrasound False Negative Mechanisms in Retroperitoneal Fibrosis, and Renal Resistive Index (RI) Calculation.

sections.content:
Obstructive Uropathy 是引發 Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) 與 Progressing Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) 的重要可逆因素：
1. **Anatomical Subtypes of Urinary Tract Obstruction**: 阻塞按病因位置分為 Intrinsic (Intraluminal vs Intramural) 與 Extrinsic Causes。Intraluminal 包括 Calculi, Blood Clots, Sloughed Renal Papilla；Intramural 包括 Ureteral Strictures, Urothelial Carcinoma, Congenital UPJ Obstruction；Extrinsic 則源自 Pelvic/Retroperitoneal Masses, Lymphoma, Aortic Aneurysms, 以及 Retroperitoneal Fibrosis (RPF / Ormond Disease)。RPF 的特徵性纖維化斑塊常包繞並侵犯 Mid-ureter，牽拉兩側輸尿管向中線靠攏 (Medial Deviation)。
2. **Ultrasound False Negative Pitfalls & Renal Resistive Index (RI)**: 超音波為無創評估 Hydronephrosis 的首選，但在特定情況下會呈現 False Negative (無水腎但有嚴重阻塞)：(a) Hyperacute Obstruction (< 24-48 hours)，集合系統尚未充分擴張；(b) 體液重度蓄積或 Volume Depletion，尿流量極低；(c) Retroperitoneal Fibrosis，因為包繞於輸尿管周圍的緻密纖維化組織限制了輸尿管與腎盂的順應性擴張。此時應結合 Doppler Ultrasound 測定 Renal Resistive Index (RI = [PSV - EDV] / PSV)。正常 RI < 0.70；當阻塞發生時，腎血管收縮導致 End-Diastolic Velocity (EDV) 銳減，顯著抬高 RI > 0.70 (或兩側 ΔRI > 0.05)，可精準提示存在急性物理阻塞。

| Anatomical Classification | Etiological Spectrum | Pathophysiological Target | Clinical / Diagnostic Signature | Primary Therapeutic Intervention |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Intrinsic Intraluminal** | Nephrolithiasis, Blood Clot, Sloughed Papilla | Direct mechanical luminal occlusion | Colicky flank pain, hematuria | Decompression, Lithotripsy, Stenting |
| **Intrinsic Intramural** | Ureteral Stricture, Urothelial Carcinoma | Structural tubule wall narrowing | Progressive unilateral hydronephrosis | Surgical excision, Balloon dilation |
| **Extrinsic Retroperitoneal** | Retroperitoneal Fibrosis (RPF / Ormond) | Encased mid-ureter with stiffness | Medial deviation of mid-ureter, False negative US | Steroids, Tamoxifen, Ureterolysis |
| **Vascular Hemodynamic** | Intrarenal Arteriolosclerosis | Increased renal vascular resistance | Elevated Renal Resistive Index (RI > 0.70) | Decompression of obstructive pressure |

| Diagnostic Modality / Parameter | Normal Threshold | Findings in Acute Obstruction | Diagnostic Pitfalls & False Negatives | Clinical Recommendation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Renal Ultrasound (B-mode)** | Pelvis diameter < 10mm | Dilated calices & pelvic hydronephrosis | False negative in RPF, volume depletion, hyperacute < 24h | Combine with Doppler RI assessment |
| **Renal Resistive Index (RI)** | RI < 0.70 | **RI > 0.70 (or ΔRI > 0.05)** | False positive in severe hypotension, intrinsic CKD | High sensitivity for acute obstructive renal vasoconstriction |
| **Non-contrast Helical CT** | Intact renal parenchyma | Hydroureter, perinephric stranding | Radiation exposure, high cost | Gold standard for stone & retroperitoneal fibrosis mapping |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Obstructive Hydronephrosis Cascade**: Ureteral Occlusion ➔ Intraluminal Pressure Elevation ➔ Proximal Tubular Pressure Surge ➔ Renal Arteriolar Vasoconstriction ➔ Elevated RI (> 0.70) & Decreased GFR.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **RPF Ultrasound Trap**: 切勿僅因超音波無 Hydronephrosis 即排除 RPF 引發之阻塞；RPF 的強固纖維化束縛會阻止腎盂擴張，此時升高之 RI (> 0.70) 與 CT / MRI 為診斷關鍵。

sections.heading: UUO vs BUO Hemodynamic Triphasic Cascades & Post-Obstructive Electrolyte Handling

diagram.caption: Figure 1.2: Triphasic Hemodynamic Response in Unilateral Ureteral Obstruction (UUO) versus Bilateral Ureteral Obstruction (BUO), Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD) Management, and Post-Relief Phosphate Retention.

Brenner 11e Fig. 37.9: Enhanced Expression of Angiotensin II (Ang II) and Downstream TGF-β Signaling in Post-Obstructive Renal Fibrosis.

Figure 1.2: Triphasic Hemodynamic Response in Unilateral Ureteral Obstruction (UUO) versus Bilateral Ureteral Obstruction (BUO), Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD) Management, and Post-Relief Phosphate Retention.

sections.content:
UUO 與 BUO 的血液動力學與電解質調控反應存在本質上的生理差異：
1. **Triphasic Hemodynamic Response in UUO**: (a) Phase I (0-1.5 hours): 輸尿管壓突增，促使局域 Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) 與 Nitric Oxide (NO) 釋放，引發 Afferent Arteriolar Vasodilation，血流量 (RBF) 暫時上升，Proximal Tubular Pressure (PT) 顯著升高；(b) Phase II (1.5-5 hours): Intraluminal backpressure 持續傳導，Efferent Arteriolar Vasoconstriction 佔主導，RBF 開始下滑而 PT 維持高檔；(c) Phase III (> 5-24 hours): Thromboxane A2 (TXA2), Angiotensin II (Ang II), 以及 Endothelin-1 (ET-1) 強烈介導 Afferent Arteriolar Vasoconstriction，使 RBF 與 PT 雙雙劇烈下降，GFR 嚴重受損。
2. **Hemodynamic Differences: UUO vs BUO**: 在 BUO (或單腎阻塞) 中，因體液無法排出導致 Uremic Solutes 蓄積與 Atrial Natriuretic Peptide (ANP) 大量釋放，相較於 UUO，BUO 的 Phase I/II RBF 下降較為延緩，且 PT 高壓維持時間顯著延長。
3. **Post-Relief Electrolyte Handling & Phosphate Retention Trap**: 當 UUO 阻塞解除後，對側正常腎臟已代償性排泄過量水鹽，且受損側腎元之 Na-K-ATPase 與 Na-Pi cotransporters (NaPi-IIa/IIc) 上調，因此 **UUO 解除後磷會出現暫時性 Phosphate Retention**；相對地，BUO 解除後，因蓄積海量尿素等 Osmotic Solutes，會誘發暴發性 Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD)，伴隨大量 Na+, K+, Mg2+ 與 Phosphate 隨尿流失。POD 處置應給予 0.45% Saline 補充電解質，且補液量維持於尿流量之 50-75%，避免維持 POD 生理循環。
4. **Post-Obstructive Fibrosis Mechanisms**: 阻塞引發之 Renal Fibrosis 主要由 Ang II 激活 Subepithelial Fibroblasts 及驅動 Transforming Growth Factor-beta 1 (TGF-β1) 介導，引發 Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition (EMT)。早期使用 ACEi / ARB 或 Pirfenidone 能顯著減緩病理進展。

| Hemodynamic Phase | Duration | Renal Blood Flow (RBF) | Proximal Tubular Pressure (PT) | Primary Vasoactive Mediators |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Phase I (Hyperemic Phase)** | 0 - 1.5 hours | **Increased (↑)** | **Increased (↑)** | PGE2, Nitric Oxide (NO) vasodilatations |
| **Phase II (Transition Phase)** | 1.5 - 5.0 hours | **Decreasing (↓)** | **Sustained High (↑)** | Efferent vasoconstriction, Angiotensin II |
| **Phase III (Chronic Obstructive)** | > 5 - 24 hours | **Markedly Decreased (↓↓)** | **Decreased (↓)** | Thromboxane A2, Ang II, Endothelin-1 |

| Physiological / Electrolyte Parameter | Unilateral Ureteral Obstruction (UUO) | Bilateral Ureteral Obstruction (BUO) | Clinical Significance & Management |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Systemic Volume / ANP Status** | Normal (Euvolemic, Contralateral comp.) | **Volume Expansion & High ANP** | BUO induces massive natriuretic surge |
| **Post-Relief Diuresis Pattern** | Minimal / Normal urine output | **Massive Post-Obstructive Diuresis** | BUO requires electrolyte & volume replacement |
| **Post-Relief Phosphate Handling** | **Phosphate Retention (Impaired ex.)** | **Phosphate Wasting (Solute diuresis)** | UUO relief leads to transient hyperphosphatemia |
| **Fibrotic Signaling Pathway** | Ang II / TGF-β1 driven EMT | Ang II / TGF-β1 driven EMT | ACEi/ARB therapy mitigates chronic renal scar |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **UUO Post-Relief Phosphate Cascade**: UUO Obstruction ➔ Contralateral Renal Compensation ➔ Affected Kidney Tubular Transporter Upregulation ➔ Obstruction Relief ➔ Reduced Filtered Load in Affected Kidney ➔ **Transient Serum Phosphate Retention**.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **UUO vs BUO Relief Electrolyte Trap**: 絕不可將 UUO 與 BUO 解除後的電解質變化混為一談；BUO 解除後為全電解質大量流失之 POD，而 UUO 解除後則因單側腎元運送體上調特徵，出現 **Phosphate Retention**。

modules.moduleTitle: 2. Nephrolithiasis, Dietary Factors & Metabolic Stone Disorders
modules.studyGuide: 本模組精通 Nephrolithiasis 的生理學、飲食調控與罕見代謝性結石疾病。重點解析 Vitamin C (Ascorbate 轉化為 Oxalate)、Vitamin D (腸道鈣吸收與 hypercalciuria)、Dietary Calcium (腸道結合草酸 vs 低鈣飲食增加草酸吸收背離)、Oxalate 與 Fructose (Purine 降解與 ATP 耗竭) 等飲食影響；Primary Hyperoxaluria (PH) 結晶形態、分型 (Type I/II/III，特別強調 Type III HOGA1 為 gain-of-function/metabolic shift)、尿液代謝物分型鑑別 (Glycolate, L-glycerate, HOG) 以及 RNAi 標靶藥物 Lumasiran (HAO1 抑制劑) 治療；Cystine Stones 六角形結晶、Type A (SLC3A1) / Type B (SLC7A9) 轉運體缺陷、鹼化尿液與 Thiol-binding 處置 (絕對不可與 Cystinosis 搞混)；以及 Struvite 感染性結石之 Risk Factors, Urease-producing Organisms (Proteus, Klebsiella, Providencia, Ureaplasma urealyticum 等可能 Culture Negative 菌種) 與治療對策。

sections.content:
Nephrolithiasis / Urolithiasis 的形成涉及複雜的飲食因子與遺傳性代謝病理：
1. **Dietary Influences on Lithogenesis**: (a) Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid): 過量攝取於體內非酵素性代謝轉化為 Oxalate，顯著增加 Calcium Oxalate 結晶飽和度；(b) Vitamin D: 促進腸道鈣吸收，引發 Absorptive Hypercalciuria；(c) Dietary Calcium: **適度高鈣飲食能於腸腔中與 Oxalate 結合形成不溶性 Calcium Oxalate 隨糞便排出**；反之，盲目限鈣飲食會使腸道游離 Oxalate 大量增加被吸收，引發 Enteric Hyperoxaluria；(d) Fructose: 於肝臟磷酸化過程中快速耗竭 ATP，活化 Purine Catabolism 並增加 Uric Acid 生成，同時降低尿液 pH。
2. **Primary Hyperoxaluria (PH) Subtypes & Genetics**: (a) PH Type I: *AGXT* 基因突變致 Alanine-Glyoxylate Aminotransferase 缺陷，Glyoxalate 積聚轉化為 Oxalate；尿液中 **Glycolate** 顯著升高；(b) PH Type II: *GRHPR* 基因突變致 Glyoxylate/Hydroxypyruvate Reductase 缺陷；尿液中 **L-Glycerate** 顯著升高；(c) PH Type III: *HOGA1* 基因突變，導致 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate aldolase 活性改變，透過 Gain-of-Function 代謝流轉向 (Metabolic Shunt) 產生過量 Glyoxylate 與 Oxalate；尿液中 **4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate (HOG)** 升高。
3. **Lumasiran Targeted RNAi Therapy**: Lumasiran 為針對 *HAO1* mRNA 的 siRNA 雙鏈分子，專一性降解肝臟 Glycolate Oxidase (HAO1)，阻斷 Glycolate 轉化為 Glyoxalate，源頭切斷 PH Type I 病患的 Oxalate 生成。

| Dietary / Metabolic Factor | Gastrointestinal / Hepatic Target | Physicochemical Impact on Urine | Stone Risk Modulation | Clinical Recommendation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **High Vitamin C (> 1000mg/d)** | Hepatic Non-enzymatic Degradation | Increases Urinary Oxalate surge | **Increases CaOx Stone Risk** | Restrict high-dose ascorbic acid supplements |
| **Low Dietary Calcium** | Decreased Intestinal Oxalate Binding | Increases Free Oxalate Absorption | **Increases CaOx Stone Risk (Paradoic)** | Maintain normal dietary Ca (1000-1200mg/d) |
| **High Fructose Consumption** | Hepatic ATP Depletion & Purine Flux | Hyperuricosuria & Low Urine pH | **Increases Uric Acid & CaOx Risk** | Reduce high-fructose corn syrup beverages |
| **Lumasiran RNAi Agent** | Silences Hepatic *HAO1* mRNA | Drops Urinary Oxalate dramatically | **Treats PH Type I Aggressively** | Approved for Primary Hyperoxaluria Type I |

| Primary Hyperoxaluria Subtype | Mutated Gene & Enzyme Defect | Pathophysiological Mechanism | Diagnostic Urinary Biomarker | Targeted Therapeutic Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PH Type I** | *AGXT* (Hepatic AGT deficiency) | Glyoxylate accumulation in peroxisomes | **Elevated Urinary Glycolate** | **Lumasiran (RNAi)**, Pyridoxine (B6), Liver Tx |
| **PH Type II** | *GRHPR* (GRHPR deficiency) | Hydroxypyruvate pathway block | **Elevated Urinary L-Glycerate** | Fluid hyperhydration, Citrate alkalization |
| **PH Type III** | *HOGA1* (HOGA deficiency / Gain-of-function) | Hydroxyproline cleavage pathway shift | **Elevated Urinary HOG / DHOG** | Conservative hydration, Magnesium citrate |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **PH Type I Lumasiran Pathway**: *AGXT* Mutation ➔ Peroxisomal Glyoxylate Accumulation ➔ Oxidation to Oxalate by HAO1 ➔ **Lumasiran siRNA Administration** ➔ Cleavage of *HAO1* mRNA ➔ Suppression of Oxalate Surge.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Dietary Calcium Restriction Trap**: 切勿建議 CaOx 結石患者嚴格限鈣；限鈣會使腸道失去 binding oxalate 的能力，反而引發重度 Enteric Hyperoxaluria 增加結石風險。

sections.heading: Cystinuria Transporter Genetics vs Cystinosis & Urease-Producing Struvite Lithiasis

diagram.caption: Figure 2.2: Molecular Transporters in Cystinuria (SLC3A1 / SLC7A9) vs Lysosomal Cystinosis (CTNS), Hexagonal Benzene Ring Crystals, and Struvite Infection Stone Microbiology.

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 38.25: Hexagonal Benzene Ring Morphology of Cystine Crystals and Chemical Structure of Cystine Dimer.
Brenner 11e Fig. 38.13: Protective Effects of Citrate Against Urolithiasis and Calcium Complexation.
Figure 2.2: Molecular Transporters in Cystinuria (SLC3A1 / SLC7A9) vs Lysosomal Cystinosis (CTNS), Hexagonal Benzene Ring Crystals, and Struvite Infection Stone Microbiology.

sections.content:
遺傳性與感染性尿路結石之分子遺傳與微生物學細節剖析：
1. **Cystinuria Transporter Defect & Hexagonal Crystals**: Cystinuria 為體染色體隱性遺傳之 Proximal Tubule 與腸道二元氨基酸 (COAL: Cystine, Ornithine, Arginine, Lysine) 轉運體缺陷。Type A 由 *SLC3A1* (編碼 rBAT 亞基) 突變所致；Type B 由 *SLC7A9* (編碼 b0,+AT 亞基) 突變所致。Cystine 在酸性尿液中溶解度極低，尿沉渣呈現特徵性 **Hexagonal Benzene-Ring Crystals**。治療包括大量飲水、**鹼化尿液 (Target Urine pH > 7.0-7.5)**、以及使用 Thiol-containing Complexing Agents (Tiopronin, D-Penicillamine)。
2. **Cystinuria vs Cystinosis Differential Trap**: **切勿將 Cystinuria 與 Cystinosis 搞混**！Cystinosis 為 *CTNS* 基因突變致 Lysosomal Cystine Transporter (Cystinosin) 缺陷，導致 Cystine 結晶蓄積於全身溶氧體 (如角膜、骨髓、腎臟)，引發 Renal Fanconi Syndrome 與多器官衰竭，治療需給予 Cysteamine；Cystinosis **不會**形成尿路結石！
3. **Struvite (Infection) Stones Pathophysiology**: Struvite 結石成分為 Magnesium Ammonium Phosphate ($MgNH_4PO_4 \cdot 6H_2O$)。Risk factors 包括 Neurogenic Bladder, Indwelling Catheters, Female gender。由具有 **Urease** 的致病菌驅動，將尿素分解為 Ammonia ($NH_3$) 與 $CO_2$，使尿液 pH 劇烈上升至 > 7.5-8.0。高濃度 $NH_4^+$ 與 $PO_4^{3-}$ 誘發 **Coffin-Lid Crystals**。
4. **Urease-Producing Microbiology**: 常見菌種包括 *Proteus mirabilis*, *Klebsiella pneumoniae*, *Pseudomonas aeruginosa*, *Providencia*, *Corynebacterium urealyticum*；特別注意 **Ureaplasma urealyticum & Mycoplasma hominis** 亦具高度 Urease 活性，但因無細胞壁，在常規尿液培養皿中呈現 **Culture Negative**。治療首重手術完全清除石塊 (Staghorn Calculus)，配合 Acetohydroxamic Acid (AHA) 抑制劑。

| Metabolic Disorder | Mutated Gene / Organelle Site | Defective Transport System | Pathognomonic Urinalysis Feature | Primary Pharmacotherapy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cystinuria (Type A)** | *SLC3A1* (rBAT subunit) | Proximal Tubule COAL Transporter | **Hexagonal Benzene-Ring Crystals** | Potassium Citrate (pH > 7.5), Tiopronin |
| **Cystinuria (Type B)** | *SLC7A9* (b0,+AT subunit) | Proximal Tubule COAL Transporter | **Hexagonal Benzene-Ring Crystals** | Potassium Citrate (pH > 7.5), Tiopronin |
| **Cystinosis (Systemic)** | *CTNS* (Lysosomal membrane) | Lysosomal Cystinosin efflux pump | **Fanconi Syndrome (No Urinary Stones)** | Oral & Ophthalmic Cysteamine |
| **Struvite Lithiasis** | Urease-producing Bacteria | Bacterial Urease enzyme hydrolyzes Urea | **Coffin-Lid Crystals & Alkaline pH > 7.5** | Surgical clearance, AHA (Urease Inhibitor) |

| Urease-Producing Microorganism | Gram Stain & Morphology | Routine Urine Culture Growth | Distinct Clinical / Microbiological Feature |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Proteus mirabilis*** | Gram-negative Rod | **Positive (Swarming growth)** | Most common cause of staghorn infection stones |
| ***Klebsiella pneumoniae*** | Gram-negative Rod | **Positive** | Encapsulated, highly resistant nosocomial pathogen |
| ***Corynebacterium urealyticum*** | Gram-positive Rod | **Positive (Slow growth)** | Encrusted cystitis & alkaline struvite stones |
| ***Ureaplasma urealyticum*** | Fastidious Mollicutes | **CULTURE NEGATIVE (Routine Agar)** | Lacks cell wall; requires specialized PCR/culture |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Struvite Lithiasis Pathway**: Urease-producing Organism Infection ➔ Bacterial Urease Hydrolyzes Urea to $NH_3$ ➔ Alkalinization of Urine (pH > 7.5) ➔ $PO_4^{3-}$ & $NH_4^+$ Surge ➔ **Coffin-Lid Struvite Precipitation**.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Cystinuria vs Cystinosis Trap**: 切勿混淆兩者；Cystinuria 為腎小管重吸收缺陷引發尿路六角形結石；Cystinosis 為溶氧體蓄積引發 Fanconi Syndrome，**完全不形成尿路結石**。

modules.moduleTitle: 3. Onconephrology, Tumor Lysis Syndrome & Renal Neoplasms
modules.studyGuide: 本模組精通 Onconephrology 與腎臟惡性腫瘤。重點剖析 Cairo-Bishop criteria 對於 Tumor Lysis Syndrome (TLS) 之 Laboratory TLS (Hyperuricemia, Hyperkalemia, Hyperphosphatemia, Hypocalcemia) 與 Clinical TLS (AKI, Cardiac Arrhythmia, Seizures) 診斷標準及 Rasburicase 處置；Papillary RCC (pRCC Type 1 vs Type 2) 之 MET 基因突變、Fumarate Hydratase (FH) 缺陷、預後與流行病學差異；Multiple Myeloma 引發 Cast Nephropathy 微觀病理及其與 MGRS/MGUS 之鑑別；以及新型標靶藥物 Belzutifan (Welireg) 選擇性抑制 HIF-2α 治療 Clear Cell RCC 與 Von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) 疾病之分子機制。

sections.content:
Tumor Lysis Syndrome (TLS) 是血液腫瘤或高腫瘤負荷癌症在化療後引發之暴發性腫瘤溶解與代謝危機：
1. **Cairo-Bishop Diagnostic Criteria for TLS**: 診斷區分為 Laboratory TLS (LTLS) 與 Clinical TLS (CTLS)。
   - **Laboratory TLS (LTLS)**: 在化療啟動前 3 天至啟動後 7 天內，符合以下 4 項電解質/代謝異常中之 **2 項或以上** (或較基線變化 > 25%)：(1) Uric Acid $\ge 8.0$ mg/dL；(2) Potassium $\ge 6.0$ mEq/L；(3) Phosphorus $\ge 4.5$ mg/dL (兒童 $\ge 6.5$ mg/dL)；(4) Calcium $\le 7.0$ mg/dL (或 Ionized $Ca^{2+} < 1.12$ mmol/L)。
   - **Clinical TLS (CTLS)**: 必須符合 LTLS，且疊加以下 **1 項或以上** 之臨床器官機能損害：(1) Acute Kidney Injury (Serum Creatinine $\ge 1.5$ 倍年齡對照上限)；(2) Cardiac Arrhythmia or Sudden Death；(3) Seizures / Neurological Alterations。
2. **Urate Nephropathy & Rasburicase Mechanism**: 大量核酸降解釋放 Purines，經 Xanthine Oxidase 代謝為 Uric Acid。在酸性集合管中沉積引發 Acute Urate Nephropathy。Allopurinol 僅能抑制 Xanthine Oxidase 阻止 *新* 尿酸合成；而 **Rasburicase (Recombinant Urate Oxidase)** 能將已形成之高毒性 Uric Acid 催化轉化為高度可溶且易經腎臟排泄之 **Allantoin**，為中高風險 TLS 之金標準治療方案。

| TLS Category / Criterion | Diagnostic Threshold Parameter | Timeline Relative to Therapy | Associated Pathophysiological Impact | First-line Interventional Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Laboratory TLS (LTLS)** | $\ge 2$ of: Uric acid $\ge 8$, $K \ge 6$, $P \ge 4.5$, $Ca \le 7$ | Within -3 days to +7 days | Intracellular electrolyte burst | Vigorous IV Hydration, Rasburicase |
| **Clinical TLS (CTLS)** | LTLS + $\ge 1$ of: AKI, Arrhythmia, Seizure | Direct consequence of LTLS | End-organ damage & mortality risk | Hemodialysis, Intensive Care monitoring |
| **Allopurinol Therapy** | Xanthine Oxidase Competitive Inhibitor | Pre-chemotherapy prophylaxis | Blocks *new* uric acid synthesis | Low-risk TLS; does *not* clear existing uric acid |
| **Rasburicase Therapy** | Recombinant Urate Oxidase Enzyme | Acute therapy for High-risk TLS | Converts Uric Acid to soluble Allantoin | High-risk TLS; rapid intravenous clearance |

| Metabolic Parameter | Pathophysiological Cascade Source | Clinical Manifestation Target | Direct Renal / Cardiac Risk | Prevention / Treatment Modality |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hyperuricemia** | Purine nucleic acid catabolism | Intratubular Urate Crystal precipitation | Acute Urate Nephropathy & AKI | Rasburicase, Allopurinol, Hydration |
| **Hyperkalemia** | Massive intracellular K+ release | Cardiac conduction blocks & Arrythmias | Ventricular Fibrillation & Asystole | Insulin/Dextrose, Calcium Gluconate, Dialysis |
| **Hyperphosphatemia** | Intracellular organic phosphate efflux | Calcium-Phosphate precipitation | Nephrocalcinosis & Microvascular block | Phosphate binders, Hemodialysis |
| **Hypocalcemia** | Secondary to Phosphate binding | Tetany, Chvostek sign, Seizures | QT prolongation & Cardiac arrest | Asymptomatic: Do *not* give Ca; Severe: IV Ca |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Cairo-Bishop TLS Pathway**: Tumor Chemotherapy Lysis ➔ Purine & Electrolyte Burst ➔ **LTLS Met (Uric Acid $\ge 8$, $K \ge 6$)** ➔ Urate Intratubular Precipitation ➔ **CTLS Manifestation (AKI / Arrhythmia)** ➔ Urgent Rasburicase Administration.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Allopurinol vs Rasburicase Trap**: 切勿於暴發性 Hyperuricemia 時單用 Allopurinol；Allopurinol 不能分解已存在的血中尿酸，高風險 TLS 必須立即使用 Rasburicase 直接將尿酸降解為 Allantoin。

sections.content:
腎臟惡性腫瘤分子遺傳學與腫瘤腎臟病學進階剖析：
1. **Papillary RCC (pRCC) Type 1 vs Type 2 Subtypes**: (a) Type 1 pRCC: 由 *MET* 原致癌基因 Gain-of-Function 突變或 7/17 號染色體三體 (Trisomy 7/17) 驅動；組織學呈現 Low grade、單層小細胞、Basophilic Cytoplasm、預後較佳；(b) Type 2 pRCC / HLRCC: 源自 *FH* (Fumarate Hydratase) 基因 Loss-of-Function 突變；組織學呈現 High grade、大細胞、Voluminous Eosinophilic Cytoplasm、顯著核仁伴隨 Perinucleolar Halo；侵襲性極強、易早期轉移、預後極差。
2. **Multiple Myeloma Cast Nephropathy vs MGRS**: Cast Nephropathy 為單株 Free Light Chains (FLCs) 與 Tamm-Horsfall Protein 於遠端小管共沉澱，形成硬化破裂之嗜酸性 Intratubular Casts 引發急性 AKI；Urine Dipstick 呈現 Negative (Overflow Proteinuria)。相較之下，Monoclonal Gammopathy of Renal Significance (MGRS) 為低腫瘤負荷下單株蛋白引發之免疫複合物或澱粉樣沉積腎病變 (如 AL Amyloidosis, LCDD, PGNMID)。
3. **Belzutifan (Welireg) Mechanism in Clear Cell RCC**: 在 Von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) 缺陷之 Clear Cell RCC (ccRCC) 中，pVHL 缺失導致 HIF-2α 無法被泛素化降解而於核內蓄積。Belzutifan 為小分子選擇性 **HIF-2α 抑制劑**，專一性結合 HIF-2α PAS-B 結合腔，阻斷 HIF-2α 與 HIF-1β 形成異二聚體 (Heterodimerization)，徹底切斷 VEGF, PDGF, Cyclin D1 等下游血管增生與腫瘤增殖基因轉錄。

| Renal Carcinoma Subtype | Dominant Genetic Mutation | Histopathological Microscopic Signature | Clinical Aggressiveness | Primary Targeted Therapeutic Path |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Type 1 Papillary RCC** | *MET* proto-oncogene gain-of-function | Single layer small cells, Basophilic cytoplasm | Indolent / Favorable prognosis | MET Inhibitors (e.g., Foretinib, Savolitinib) |
| **Type 2 Papillary RCC** | *FH* (Fumarate Hydratase) loss-of-function | Eosinophilic cytoplasm, Prominent nucleoli | **Highly Aggressive / Poor** | Anti-VEGF + Erlotinib / Immune Checkpoint |
| **Clear Cell RCC (ccRCC)** | *VHL* gene inactivation (3p25) | Clear cytoplasm (lipid/glycogen), Network caps | High vascularity & systemic risk | **Belzutifan (HIF-2α inhibitor)**, TKI, Anti-PD1 |

| Parameter / Aspect | Myeloma Cast Nephropathy | Monoclonal Gammopathy of Renal Significance (MGRS) | MGUS (Monoclonal Gammopathy of Undetermined Sig.) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tumor Burden** | High (Clonal Plasma Cells > 10%) | Low (Pre-malignant B-cell clone) | Low (No end-organ damage) |
| **Dominant Renal Lesion** | Obstructive Fractured Intratubular Casts | Glomerular / Interstitial Monoclonal Deposition | **No Renal Injury Present** |
| **Urine Dipstick Status** | **Negative / Trace (Bence Jones FLCs)** | **Strongly Positive (Albuminuria)** | Negative |
| **Primary Therapeutic Goal** | Emergency Chemotherapy to halt FLCs | Suppress Clone to save Kidney | Observation / Watchful Waiting |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Belzutifan Targeted Pathway**: *VHL* Inactivation ➔ Impaired Ubiquitination ➔ **HIF-2α Accumulation** ➔ **Belzutifan Binding to PAS-B Domain** ➔ Blocks HIF-2α/HIF-1β Dimerization ➔ Downregulates VEGF & Growth Factors.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **pRCC Subtype Prognosis Trap**: 切勿將 Type 1 與 Type 2 pRCC 混為一談；Type 1 屬於 MET 突變之預後良好型，而 Type 2 屬於 *FH* 缺陷之高侵襲性惡性腫瘤。
